'''Herron Morvis VII''' was the [[Gender|male]] descendant of [[Herron Morvis]] and [[Morvis (senator)]] and renowned as an unscruplous financier who lived during the conflict with the [[Eternal Empire]]. He claimed to have reliable information upon dozens of CEO's from all over the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=crewskill|Slicing|Dirty Laundry}}</ref>
